name: Cronicle Asher
original_name: クロノクル・アシャー
source:
From: Mobile Suit V Gundam
A soldier with BESPA, the Zanscare Empire military forces, and the brother of Queen Maria. However, he disliked receiving special treatment because of his royal-adjacent position and sought to earn his own glory on the frontlines.
